{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Brazil|Brazilian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Crab | Crab recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Seafood | Seafood recipes]]
==Ingredients==

*2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (900 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Crab|crabmeat]], drained if using canned
*3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], peeled, seeded and chopped
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Palm Oil|palm oil]]
*¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Coconut Milk|coconut milk]]
*2 tbsp fresh [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]]
*2 tbsp fresh chopped [[Cookbook:Green Onion|green onions]]
*4 tbsp [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*[[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|Bread crumbs]]
*Grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]], to taste
*Crab shells, scallop shells, or small oven-proof dishes

==Procedure==

#Heat olive oil and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] onions until soft. 
#Stir in crabmeat for 3–5 minutes. Add tomatoes and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for 5–8 minutes.
#Add coconut milk, salt, pepper and palm oil, cooking for 3–5 minutes.
#Remove from heat, add flour at small quantities, stirring continually. Bring the pan back to heat, cooking until you get a cream. Stir in parsley and green onions. Remove from heat.
#Fill the shells or oven-proof dishes with this mixture, top with bread crumbs mixed with Parmesan cheese. 
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 15–20 minutes or until lightly brown.
